correctness.rationale: The all-positive trace forces a directed branching. A spanning arborescence support of n-1 arcs fails the trace retaining nonroot-tail arcs and forbidding root-tail arcs. For any branching S of size at most n-2 and any P subset S, among n-|P|-1 nonroot P-components at most |S|-|P| <= n-|P|-2 have forbidden root-attachment arcs, leaving an open component; attach open components to root, blocked ones through that open component. This constructs all traces. Matrix-tree minor nI-J counts each rooted forest. Exhaustive independent Prüfer trace checker passes 2<=n<=5 with 800 sampled n=6 supports.
